name: Deflecting Swat
oracle_text:
If you control a commander, you may cast this spell without paying its mana cost.
You may choose new targets for target spell or ability.
blocked_sentences: You may choose new targets for target spell or ability.

needs.what: an op that retargets an object already on the stack -- given a targeted spell or ability the resolving effect points at, let its controller optionally choose new legal targets for it (114.6/115.7), leaving the original object on the stack rather than copying it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The only retargeting in the engine is the `new_targets` boolean on `copy_spell` (src/commanderblitz/engine/effects/ops_stack.py `_choose_new_targets`), and the loader refuses `new_targets` on any other op -- it retargets a freshly made copy, never the original, so `copy_spell` would leave the opposing spell still aimed where it was. No op in `ops` mutates the target list of an existing stack object; `counter` is the nearest thing that touches another spell at all and it removes it instead of redirecting it.
